_doc: SINGLE source for each live sleeve's SIZING budget and its RETURN base (owner's decision, 2026-10-07). `budget` (and trend's `overlay_mult`) is what the runner sizes with, read via risk_guard.documented_sizing; `amount` is the return denominator. NOT capital allocations: the sleeves share one account's collateral, so the amounts overlap and do not sum to NAV. risk_guard.ALLOCATIONS are guard CEILINGS, never a source of budgets. Change a value ONLY together with a dated row in docs/capital_bases.md, in its own commit; this file is kept byte-identical in algo_trading, trend-overlay and options-vrp.

magic-formula.represents: inception NAV: the account's funded size when magic-formula went live (read from its state.json inception_nav; this figure documents it)
magic-formula.sizing: budget CAPS the deployment base: sizing is gap-to-NAV against min(NAV, budget), so the sleeve deploys up to 50k and never compounds past it; amount (inception NAV) is the return base only

trend-overlay.represents: notional sizing budget: BUDGET 50,000 x OVERLAY_MULT 1.5

options-vrp.represents: BUDGET: the risk base that sizes each spread (3% max loss per position)
